diff --git a/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_body_parser.brp b/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_body_parser.brp
index 12b4bb377..2e622df67 100644
--- a/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_body_parser.brp
+++ b/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_body_parser.brp
@@ -52,7 +52,7 @@ import:
 
 -- Whether `break` and `continue` have a loop to leave. A parameter: a nested
 -- loop body passes `InsideLoop` down and nothing saves or restores it.
-enum BodyContext:
+fixed union BodyContext:
 	OutsideLoop
 	InsideLoop
 
@@ -1189,12 +1189,12 @@ private pure func parse_block_form_statement(state: ParseState, context: BodyCon
 -- ends in a colon on its own line, and indented blocks closed by dedents, so
 -- each ends where the next statement may already begin.
 
-private enum ConcurrentParameterOwner:
+private fixed union ConcurrentParameterOwner:
 	ConcurrentBlockOwner
 	ConcurrentForOwner
 
 
-private enum ConcurrentParameterName:
+private fixed union ConcurrentParameterName:
 	ConcurrentCount
 	ConcurrentTimeout
 	ConcurrentUnknown
@@ -1347,7 +1347,7 @@ private pure func parse_receive_arm_header(state: ParseState, context: BodyConte
 
 
 -- A with header contains completed binder/type/value children.
-private enum WithOperator:
+private fixed union WithOperator:
 	AcquireWithValue
 	AcquireWithTry
 
diff --git a/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_expression_parser.brp b/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_expression_parser.brp
index f86a8fac1..3f5fd679d 100644
--- a/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_expression_parser.brp
+++ b/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_expression_parser.brp
@@ -59,7 +59,7 @@ record ExpressionValue {
 }
 
 
-enum ExpressionRoot:
+fixed union ExpressionRoot:
 	NameRoot
 	SubscriptRoot
 	TupleRoot
@@ -68,7 +68,7 @@ enum ExpressionRoot:
 	OtherRoot
 
 
-enum OperandEnding:
+fixed union OperandEnding:
 	PlainOperand
 	ControlOperand
 	BlockLambdaOperand
@@ -82,7 +82,7 @@ union ValueParse:
 
 -- Only the outer prefix/postfix of an expression statement may finish a
 -- subscript as a place. Every nested expression uses ValueContext.
-private enum ExpressionContext:
+private fixed union ExpressionContext:
 	ValueContext
 	StatementContext
 
@@ -102,7 +102,7 @@ private union PostfixStep:
 
 
 -- The brackets of a postfix step: a list literal is an atom, never a step.
-private enum PostfixDelimiter:
+private fixed union PostfixDelimiter:
 	CallDelimiter
 	SubscriptDelimiter
 
@@ -116,7 +116,7 @@ private union ItemDelimiter:
 
 
 -- The four forms a `{` opens, each with its own missing-brace diagnostic.
-private enum BracedForm:
+private fixed union BracedForm:
 	RecordForm
 	UpdateForm
 	DictForm
@@ -155,12 +155,12 @@ private union ChainStep[T]:
 
 -- A consumed continuation dedent ends this expression even when its sibling
 -- starts with an operator token. This is transient parse evidence.
-enum ExpressionEnding:
+fixed union ExpressionEnding:
 	AtExpressionToken
 	AfterContinuationDedent
 
 
-private enum ContinuedField:
+private fixed union ContinuedField:
 	NoContinuedField
 	HasContinuedField
 
@@ -168,7 +168,7 @@ private enum ContinuedField:
 -- The frozen statement reader repairs one leaked chain indent for a binary
 -- whose left contains a continued field, or whose right needs the same repair.
 -- Unary wrapping deliberately does not carry this evidence.
-private enum ContinuationRepair:
+private fixed union ContinuationRepair:
 	NoContinuationRepair
 	RepairOneContinuationDedent
 
@@ -705,7 +705,7 @@ private pure func items_after[T](
 -- only the missing closing bracket. A tuple, vector or dict reads a missing
 -- item there, reports it, and counts it, which this slice does not
 -- reproduce, so it defers.
-private enum CommaBeforeEndOfSource:
+private fixed union CommaBeforeEndOfSource:
 	ReportsOnlyUnclosed
 	CountsAsMissingItem
 
diff --git a/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_function_header_parser.brp b/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_function_header_parser.brp
index 9bdafc202..064f5bb04 100644
--- a/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_function_header_parser.brp
+++ b/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_function_header_parser.brp
@@ -29,7 +29,7 @@ record FunctionHeader {
 }
 
 
-enum FunctionBodyPresence:
+fixed union FunctionBodyPresence:
 	ForwardDeclaration
 	BodyFollows
 
@@ -137,14 +137,14 @@ pure func function_body_follows(state: ParseState) -> Bool:
 
 
 -- Only an authored inline conditional can own an anchor-column else.
-private enum BodyContinuation:
+private fixed union BodyContinuation:
 	AtBodyStart
 	NoContinuation
 	AwaitingElse
 	AfterElse
 
 
-private enum PostfixContinuation:
+private fixed union PostfixContinuation:
 	NoPostfixContinuation
 	LeadingDot
 
diff --git a/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_trait_method_header_parser.brp b/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_trait_method_header_parser.brp
index 21929eb86..d440e3b07 100644
--- a/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_trait_method_header_parser.brp
+++ b/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_trait_method_header_parser.brp
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@ record TraitMethodHeader {
 }
 
 
-enum MethodBodyPresence:
+fixed union MethodBodyPresence:
 	AbstractMethod
 	DefaultBodyFollows
